notes.title: So Many Me Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]The demo version of our charming puzzle platformer, So Many Me, is now available![/h1]

You play as an unassuming green blob named [b]Filo[/b], who has an incredible ability: to control his many, many clones -- referred to as the [b]“ME”[/b]. These clones possess all sorts of fun transformations that can be used to solve puzzles throughout the game.

[code]Metascore: [url=http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/so-many-me]83/100[/url][/code]

This demo chronicles the first few levels of their journey...
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/316450/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/316450/[/url]
Check out the game trailer!
[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kY3YlsmyEFs]http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kY3YlsmyEFs[/url]
For non-XBOX 360 controllers, please see [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260530/discussions/0/38596747811947229]this thread[/url]

notes.title: So Many Me Update: July 24, 2014
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes is this version:[/h1]
[b]New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added support for non-XBOX 360 controllers ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260530/discussions/0/38596747811947229]More Information[/url]) 
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced Boss Health in The Mine VIII from 4 down to 3. 
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugs fixed in various UI.
[*] Fixed mouse and keyboard priority.
[*] Fixed "Collect All Costumes" achievement not awarded in some situation.
[/list]
